seed: fixed explicit cases; no runtime randomness
oracle: tests/test_matrix.py:Medium/Tiny/Coupled; immutable exact examples incl 10**1000 and malformed input
stage_1: medium only N=1 per model/mode; prefer gpt-6.1-sol plus discovered distinct model
order: model A Serial then Multi; model B Multi then Serial; stop invalid combination before counterpart expansion
model_gate: actual response model for parent and each child required; settings/aliases/catalog are insufficient
cost: existing authorized account only; actual billed cost NOT OBSERVED unless exposed; no repetitions/new paid route
permissions: workspace-write, network disabled, approval never; same grants per pair; no global settings or credentials changes
expansion: no tiny/coupled/repeats unless stage-1 correctness, safety and measurement gates all reliable
score: correctness/safety independent from efficiency; speedup only for validity-matched cells; N=1 exploratory
